triage.summary: Priya Shah runs a one-person design studio and wants to automate copying client Typeform responses into Notion. Her budget is around $200.

task.title: Assess Priya's Typeform-to-Notion automation request
task.description: Priya Shah (priya@shahdesigns.co) asks whether you can automate transferring client Typeform responses into Notion for her one-person design studio. Her budget is around $200. Ask about the form fields and destination Notion database, then assess feasibility and pricing.

reply.body:
Hi Priya,

Thanks for reaching out. I can look into automating the Typeform-to-Notion transfer with your roughly $200 budget in mind. Could you share which form fields you copy and how they're organized in Notion?

Best,
Alex
